432:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「As expected of you. I can't win like this.」

432:t_024:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But you can't defeat me.」

432:t_024:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You understand, don't you, $n?」

432:t_026:0.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I won't let you hurt the Captain!」

432:t_028:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Impossible! He's taking on $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ with his bare body...!」

432:t_028:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... That man is...」

432:t_028:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We've known each other for a while. I'll give you the truth at the end.」

432:t_028:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The reason I didn't answer your questions... The reason I didn't listen to your requests... It's because...」

432:t_028:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You belong to me.」

432:t_028:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I know everything about you. Your mother, your father, your sister...」

432:t_028:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And the woman you fell for too. ...Look, $n.」

432:t_028:13.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Even if it's you, $n, if you try to kill Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!」

432:t_028:14.en:
$n
「$$マキ#pilot$$ is... with $$クロノ$$... with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

432:t_028:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is a good opportunity. I'll remove the shield I placed around your mind during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

432:t_028:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now you'll feel me directly.」

432:t_029:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Those eyes...! And now both of them!!」

432:t_029:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You... don't tell me!!」

432:t_029:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's right. I am the being $n has been pursuing... In his words...」

432:t_031:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... So you've revealed your true nature as the last one.」

432:t_031:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let's go home, $$アサキム$$. We still have countless things we must do.」

432:t_032:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now you know my power.」

432:t_032:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have duties as the last one. Even the time spent dealing with you is a waste.」

432:t_033:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's all right! I'm picking up life signs!!」

432:t_034:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! What... is he!?」

432:t_034:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Reformists... Do they regard us as enemies now...?」

432:t_034:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't understand... Any of it...」

432:t_034:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, return. We'll sort out the situation.」

432:t_034:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We can't afford to stop moving. Now that we've freed the $$翠の地球$$, we'll head for the $$蒼の地球$$.」

432:t_034:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What awaits us there is $$サイデリアル$$... A battle against the $$新地球皇国$$...」

432:t_034:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The Empire and its collaborators... And the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...」

432:t_035:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's no use! We have no way to block it!」

432:t_035:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You're pulling some lousy tricks, $$サイデリアル$$!」

432:t_035:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「We'll focus on taking down the enemy instead of stopping that!」

432:t_035:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know! I'll do it for $$セツコ$$'s sake too!」

432:t_036:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... If I don't start taking this seriously, I'll be purged too, won't I...?」

432:t_036:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm sorry, but I'll be taking my leave first today.」

432:t_037:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...If you understand that, I'll expect you to act accordingly, $$サルディアス・アクス$$...」

432:t_037:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're my adjutant, after all.」

432:t_038:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I see... It still isn't enough.」

432:t_038:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Why are you helping $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

432:t_038:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Helping him? That isn't my intention.」

432:t_038:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I only ever use this wretched life of mine for my own purposes.」

432:t_039:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's fine, $$アサキム$$. Live your life however you wish.」

432:t_040:1.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「That white machine...! It's been a while, um... um...」

432:t_040:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

432:t_040:3.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「That's right, $$クロウ$$! It's been so long!」

432:t_040:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クラヴィア$$... Why... are you here?」

432:t_040:5.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Well... I tagged along with the resistance and joined the attack on this base, but...」

432:t_040:6.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I got separated from them along the way...」
